From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/Infra immersion (60-90m) & agenda options

Hi Callie — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap: you and the NovexSys team want to validate latency and cost tradeoffs for two serving patterns (single-model multi-tenant vs. model-per-tenant), confirm network topology for private deployment, and walk through our autoscaling + fallback policy. You asked for a technical immersion with our infra and ops leads to validate perf assumptions and run through a short preflight checklist.

We recommend a 60–90 minute session that includes:
- 10m quick context & success criteria (you)
- 30–40m architecture / serving runtime deep dive (Redwood)
- 15–30m hands-on capacity discussion + sample traffic profile + Q&A
- 10m next steps / mutual action plan

Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Tues 29 Sep: 9:00–10:30 or 11:00–12:30
- Wed 30 Sep: 8:30–10:00 or 13:00–14:30

Can you confirm (1) preferred window, (2) final attendee list from NovexSys (we'll need infra/SRE + product owner + one data engineer), and (3) whether you'd like a 60 or 90 minute slot? I attached a draft agenda and our mutual action plan template for planning.

Prep notes for your team: please bring a representative sample of peak qps and a short note on current tokenization/embedding choices for the models you plan to serve. If you prefer, share a short pre-read and we'll adapt the agenda.

Thanks — happy to lock once you confirm a time.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

Looking forward to it — confirmed: Tue 29 Sep, 9:00–10:30 PST (90m).
